hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.java) out=$("$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/gradlew -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" compileJava -q 2>&1) || { printf 'Compilation Java echouee apres modification de %s :\n%s\n' "$f" "$(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -30)" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -q '\.java$'; then out=$(./gradlew compileJava -q 2>&1) || { printf 'Verification fin de tache : compilation Java en echec.\n%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -30)" >&2; exit 2; }; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Verification de fin de tache (build Java)...
